# Introduction

In this post, I explore the `palmerpenguins` dataset using Python. 

The data come from the `palmerpenguins` dataset. The data were collected and
made available by Dr. Kristen Gorman and the Palmer Station, Antarctica LTER
Program.

**Data source:** [palmerpenguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/)

## Setup

```{python}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from palmerpenguins import load_penguins
```

## Loading the data

```{python}
penguins = load_penguins()

print("Rows:", penguins.shape[0])
print("Columns:", penguins.shape[1])
```

The dataset contains 344 observations and 8 variables.

# Comparing species

Calculate the number of penguins and average body mass for each species.

```{python}
species_summary = (
    penguins
    .groupby("species")
    .agg(
        n=("species", "size"),
        mean_body_mass_g=("body_mass_g", "mean"),
        sd_body_mass_g=("body_mass_g", "std")
    )
    .round(2)
)

species_summary
```

The summary shows differences in body mass among the three species. Gentoo
penguins have the highest average body mass, while Adelie penguins have the
lowest.

# Visualizing body mass

Create a boxplot to compare body mass across species.

```{python}
#| label: fig-penguin-mass
#| fig-cap: "Body mass of penguins by species."

penguins.boxplot(
    column="body_mass_g",
    by="species"
)

plt.title("Penguin Body Mass by Species")
plt.suptitle("")
plt.xlabel("Species")
plt.ylabel("Body mass (g)")
plt.show()
```

The boxplot shows that Gentoo penguins generally have greater body mass than
Adelie and Chinstrap penguins.

# Flipper length and body mass

Finally, Calculate the correlation between flipper length and body mass.

```{python}
correlation = penguins[
    ["flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g"]
].corr()

correlation
```

The correlation matrix shows a positive relationship between flipper length
and body mass. This suggests that penguins with longer flippers tend to be
heavier.

# Conclusion

The Python analysis shows differences in body mass among the three penguin
species. Gentoo penguins generally have the greatest body mass, and there is
a positive relationship between flipper length and body mass.
